document:96.text:
I don't feel dead at all.
I went back to visit my friends, and the people in town hurled stones at me. That's when it hit me.
Is this what it feels like to be an undead?
The cold doesn't bother me, so I can play in the snow for as long as I wish!
Also, I can keep going without feeling tired or hungry!
When I get bored, I can always frighten people! So cool!
document:96.source_cn:
我完全不觉得自己死了。
当我回到镇子找朋友玩时，镇上的人却拿石头丢我。直到那时候，我才知道自己变成了活死人。
这就是活死人吗？
我不会感觉到冷，想玩多久雪就可以玩多久的雪！
而且不管玩多久，我也不会感觉累和饿！
如果无聊，还可以去吓人！太酷啦！
document:96.document_title: Being an undead is the best!
